name: Item
description: An item — a product or service sold, purchased, or tracked by the QuickBooks company.

update.note: Sparse update; body must include Id and SyncToken.

fields.name: Id
fields.description: System-assigned unique identifier of the item. Read-only; required on update (in the body) and used to address get.

fields.name: SyncToken
fields.description: Version number of the object. Returned by the server; must be supplied unchanged in the body on update to avoid stale-write conflicts.

fields.name: Name
fields.description: User-recognizable name for the item. Required for create. Must be unique among items; max 100 characters. Cannot contain a colon (:).

fields.name: Type
fields.description: Classification of the item. Required for create. 'Inventory' requires QuickBooks Plus and inventory tracking enabled, and requires IncomeAccountRef, AssetAccountRef, ExpenseAccountRef, InvStartDate, QtyOnHand, and TrackQtyOnHand=true. Once set, Type is largely immutable except certain allowed conversions.

fields.name: Sku
fields.description: Stock Keeping Unit (SKU) for the item. Max 100 characters.

fields.name: Description
fields.description: Description of the item shown on sales forms. Max 4000 characters.

fields.name: Active
fields.description: Whether the item is active and available for use. Defaults to true. Inactive items are filtered from default queries.

fields.name: SubItem
fields.description: Whether this item is a sub-item (child) of another item. When true, ParentRef must be supplied. Defaults to false.

fields.name: ParentRef
fields.description: Reference to the parent item, establishing item hierarchy / sub-items. Set SubItem to true when ParentRef is used.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: Id of the parent item.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Display name of the parent item.

fields.name: Level
fields.description: Depth of the item within the parent/child hierarchy (0 for top-level). System-computed; specifies the level of the item in the hierarchy.

fields.name: FullyQualifiedName
fields.description: Fully qualified name of the item including its parent hierarchy, separated by colons (e.g. 'Parent:Child'). System-generated; max 100 characters.

fields.name: Taxable
fields.description: Whether the item is subject to sales tax. Applicable when automated sales tax is not enabled; behavior varies by company tax configuration.

fields.name: SalesTaxIncluded
fields.description: Whether the unit price/amount on sales forms already includes tax. Used in tax-inclusive jurisdictions.

fields.name: UnitPrice
fields.description: Monetary value of the item's sales price (per unit). Max length 15 digits. Applies to Service, NonInventory, and Inventory types.

fields.name: IncomeAccountRef
fields.description: Reference to the posting account that records the proceeds from the sale of this item. Required for Inventory and (when sold) Service/NonInventory items. Must reference an Income-type account.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: Id of the referenced income account.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Display name of the referenced account.

fields.name: PurchaseDesc
fields.description: Purchase description for the item, shown on purchase forms. Max 1000 characters.

fields.name: PurchaseTaxIncluded
fields.description: Whether the purchase cost already includes tax. Used in tax-inclusive jurisdictions.

fields.name: PurchaseCost
fields.description: Amount paid when buying or ordering the item (per unit cost). Max length 15 digits.

fields.name: ExpenseAccountRef
fields.description: Reference to the expense account used to pay for / track purchases of this item. Required for Inventory items (the COGS account) and for purchased Service/NonInventory items. For Inventory, must reference a Cost of Goods Sold account.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: Id of the referenced expense (or COGS) account.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Display name of the referenced account.

fields.name: AssetAccountRef
fields.description: Reference to the inventory asset account that tracks the current value of inventory on hand. Required for Inventory items; must reference an Other Current Asset account of subtype Inventory.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: Id of the referenced inventory asset account.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Display name of the referenced account.

fields.name: TrackQtyOnHand
fields.description: Whether quantity on hand is tracked for this item. Must be true for Inventory items. Once true it cannot be set back to false.

fields.name: QtyOnHand
fields.description: Current quantity of the item on hand. Required for Inventory items on create (sets the starting quantity). After create it is system-maintained via transactions and should not be set directly on update; adjust via inventory transactions.

fields.name: InvStartDate
fields.description: Date the item was first stocked / inventory tracking began. Required for Inventory items on create.

fields.name: ReorderPoint
fields.description: Quantity at which QuickBooks prompts to reorder the inventory item. Applicable to Inventory items.

fields.name: ClassRef
fields.description: Reference to the Class associated with the item. Available when class tracking is enabled.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: Id of the referenced class.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Display name of the referenced class.

fields.name: PrefVendorRef
fields.description: Reference to the preferred vendor from whom this item is purchased. Applicable to Inventory and purchased items.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: Id of the referenced vendor.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Display name of the referenced vendor.

fields.name: SalesTaxCodeRef
fields.description: Reference to the sales tax code applied when this item is sold. Applicable in non-automated-sales-tax companies.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: Id of the referenced sales tax code.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Display name of the referenced tax code.

fields.name: PurchaseTaxCodeRef
fields.description: Reference to the purchase tax code applied when this item is bought. Applicable in non-automated-sales-tax companies.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: Id of the referenced purchase tax code.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Display name of the referenced tax code.

fields.name: TaxClassificationRef
fields.description: Reference to the tax classification (product/service taxability category) for the item. Used with automated sales tax to determine taxability.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: Id/key of the referenced tax classification.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Display name of the tax classification.

fields.name: AbatementRate
fields.description: Sales tax abatement rate. Applicable only to India versions of QuickBooks Online.

fields.name: ReverseChargeRate
fields.description: Reverse charge tax rate. Applicable only to India versions of QuickBooks Online.

fields.name: ServiceType
fields.description: Sales tax service type. Applicable only to India versions of QuickBooks Online.

fields.name: ItemCategoryType
fields.description: Categorization label distinguishing products from services (e.g. 'Product' or 'Service'). Used in some locales/UI groupings.

fields.name: Source
fields.description: Origin of the item record (e.g. 'QBCommerce'). Identifies items created/synced from a connected channel.

fields.name: domain
fields.description: Internal use. Identifies the data domain; always 'QBO' for Accounting API objects.

fields.name: sparse
fields.description: Indicates that the object contains only a subset of fields (sparse representation). Set to true in sparse update bodies.

fields.name: MetaData
fields.description: Descriptive read-only metadata about the object's creation and last update.

attributes.name: CreateTime
attributes.description: Timestamp when the item was created.

attributes.name: LastUpdatedTime
attributes.description: Timestamp when the item was last modified.
